definition_en: different from what is normal
example_en: The scientist repeated the test after an aberrant result.
example_uz: Olim noodatiy natijadan keyin sinovni takrorladi.

definition_en: to formally give up a belief or claim
example_en: The leader abjured violence in public.
example_uz: Rahbar omma oldida zo'ravonlikdan rasman voz kechdi.

definition_en: sharp and unpleasant in taste or smell
example_en: An acrid smell filled the laboratory.
example_uz: Laboratoriyani o'tkir va achchiq hid qopladi.

definition_en: refusing to change an opinion or decision
example_en: She was adamant that the rule was unfair.
example_uz: U qoida adolatsiz ekaniga qat'iy ishondi.

definition_en: skillful and clever in dealing with situations
example_en: His adroit response calmed the audience.
example_uz: Uning epchil javobi tinglovchilarni tinchlantirdi.

definition_en: something that causes pain or suffering
example_en: The illness was a lifelong affliction.
example_uz: Kasallik umrboqiy azob beruvchi dard edi.

definition_en: to increase power or importance excessively
example_en: The ruler tried to aggrandize his own authority.
example_uz: Hukmdor o'z hokimiyatini haddan tashqari ulug'lashga urindi.

definition_en: to reduce fear or worry
example_en: The guide allayed our concerns about safety.
example_uz: Yo'lboshchi xavfsizlik haqidagi xavotirimizni yengillashtirdi.

definition_en: to combine into one whole
example_en: The plan will amalgamate the two departments.
example_uz: Reja ikki bo'limni birlashtiradi.

definition_en: belonging to a different historical time
example_en: The typewriter looked anachronistic in the modern office.
example_uz: Yozuv mashinasi zamonaviy ofisda zamoniga mos kelmaydigandek ko'rindi.

definition_en: an earlier event that influences a later one
example_en: The case has no clear legal antecedent.
example_uz: Bu ishning aniq huquqiy oldingi holati yo'q.

definition_en: showing no interest or enthusiasm
example_en: Many voters were apathetic about the election.
example_uz: Ko'p saylovchilar saylovga beparvo edi.

definition_en: very old-fashioned or no longer used
example_en: Some archaic words survive in legal writing.
example_uz: Ba'zi eskirgan so'zlar huquqiy yozuvda saqlanib qolgan.

definition_en: to make pain or worry less severe
example_en: The apology did little to assuage her anger.
example_uz: Kechirim uning g'azabini deyarli yumshatmadi.

definition_en: an extreme desire for money or wealth
example_en: Avarice led the official to accept bribes.
example_uz: Ochko'zlik amaldorni pora olishga olib keldi.

definition_en: too ordinary to be interesting
example_en: The speech relied on banal slogans.
example_uz: Nutq jo'n va zerikarli shiorlarga tayandi.

definition_en: kind and willing to help others
example_en: The benevolent donor funded the library.
example_uz: Mehribon donor kutubxonani moliyalashtirdi.

definition_en: noisy cheerful and energetic
example_en: Boisterous fans celebrated the victory.
example_uz: Shovqinli va jo'shqin muxlislar g'alabani nishonladilar.

definition_en: showing no concern for others' feelings
example_en: The callous remark upset the family.
example_uz: Rahmsiz gap oilani xafa qildi.

definition_en: a false statement intended to harm someone
example_en: The article was dismissed as calumny.
example_uz: Maqola tuhmat sifatida rad etildi.

definition_en: strong official criticism
example_en: The minister faced public censure for the error.
example_uz: Vazir xato uchun jamoatchilikning qattiq qoralashiga uchradi.

definition_en: to speak angrily to someone about a fault
example_en: The teacher chided him for arriving late.
example_uz: O'qituvchi uni kech kelgani uchun malomat qildi.

definition_en: careful not to take risks
example_en: Investors remained circumspect during the crisis.
example_uz: Investorlar inqiroz paytida ehtiyotkor bo'lib qoldilar.

definition_en: to force someone to do something
example_en: No one should coerce workers into overtime.
example_uz: Hech kim xodimlarni ortiqcha ishlashga majburlamasligi kerak.

definition_en: used in informal everyday speech
example_en: The dialogue contains colloquial language.
example_uz: Dialogda so'zlashuv uslubidagi til bor.

definition_en: a feeling of satisfaction that stops improvement
example_en: Complacency can cause a team to lose focus.
example_uz: O'zidan ortiqcha qoniqish jamoaning diqqatini yo'qotishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

definition_en: intended to make people less angry
example_en: Her conciliatory tone ended the argument.
example_uz: Uning kelishtiruvchi ohangi bahsni tugatdi.

definition_en: to treat two different things as one
example_en: Do not conflate opinion with evidence.
example_uz: Fikrni dalil bilan aralashtirib yubormang.

definition_en: feeling sorry for having done wrong
example_en: He sounded contrite after the mistake.
example_uz: U xatodan keyin pushaymon bo'lib ko'rindi.

definition_en: too ready to believe things
example_en: Credulous readers believed the false story.
example_uz: Tez ishonuvchan o'quvchilar yolg'on hikoyaga ishondilar.

definition_en: to reduce the quality or value of something
example_en: The scandal could debase public trust.
example_uz: Janjal jamoatchilik ishonchi qadrini tushirishi mumkin.

definition_en: to make someone or something weak
example_en: The disease can debilitate older patients.
example_uz: Kasallik keksa bemorlarni holdan toydirishi mumkin.

definition_en: the act of deliberately misleading someone
example_en: The deal was built on deceit.
example_uz: Kelishuv aldov ustiga qurilgan edi.

definition_en: polite and socially acceptable
example_en: The guests remained decorous throughout dinner.
example_uz: Mehmonlar kechki ovqat davomida odobli bo'lib qoldilar.

definition_en: lacking a clear plan or purpose
example_en: His desultory reading produced little progress.
example_uz: Uning tartibsiz o'qishi kam natija berdi.

definition_en: a long angry and critical speech
example_en: The columnist wrote a diatribe against corruption.
example_uz: Sharhlovchi korrupsiyaga qarshi achchiq tanqid yozdi.

definition_en: to free someone from a false belief
example_en: The evidence disabused us of that assumption.
example_uz: Dalillar bizni o'sha noto'g'ri fikrdan qaytardi.

definition_en: to deny responsibility or support
example_en: The company disavowed the offensive message.
example_uz: Kompaniya haqoratli xabarni rad etdi.

definition_en: to hide one's real thoughts or feelings
example_en: She tried to dissemble her disappointment.
example_uz: U hafsalasi pir bo'lganini yashirishga urindi.

definition_en: quiet and easy to control
example_en: The docile animal followed its handler.
example_uz: Itoatkor hayvon boqib yuruvchiga ergashdi.
